title: A comparative study on endothelial cell loss in nanophthalmic eyes undergoing cataract surgery by phacoemulsification

license.statement: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (article <license> and ali:license_ref https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/); not CC BY or CC0, so the record is private

indication: Visually significant cataract (LOCS III below NO5); study group: nanophthalmos (axial length below 20.5 mm, retino-choroido-scleral thickness above 1.7 mm, ACD above 1.5 mm, corneal diameter at least 11 mm; eyes below the Methods ECD threshold excluded); control group: age-matched normal eyes

groups.description: Phacoemulsification (2.8 mm temporal clear corneal incision, stop and chop, Centurion, SN60WF IOL) with concomitant prophylactic inferotemporal posterior sclerostomy; laser peripheral iridotomy at least 2 weeks before surgery; 19 eyes of 15 patients; same surgeon; prospective, 2018
Standard phacoemulsification in age-matched normal eyes; 42 eyes of 21 patients; same surgeon

series.baseline_label: Baseline (Table 3, Endothelial Cell Density block) = preoperative central ECD (specular microscopy one day before surgery, after the laser iridotomy)
series.notes: Table 3 'Study group (n=19) Mean±SD' column, rows Baseline, Month 1 and Month 3 under 'Endothelial Cell Density (ECD)'; Konan Noncon Robo specular microscopy, centre method. Per-visit n not tabulated.

series.baseline_label: Baseline (Table 3, Endothelial Cell Density block) = preoperative central ECD of the operated eye
series.notes: Table 3 'Control group (n=42) Mean±SD' column, rows Baseline, Month 1 and Month 3 under 'Endothelial Cell Density (ECD)'. Per-visit n not tabulated.

exclusions.reason: Reported as median (IQR); medians are not admissible and the absolute ECD means are used

exclusions.what: Table 2 ACD ≤2.5 and ACD >2.5 subgroups of the nanophthalmic eyes
exclusions.reason: Partition of the same eyes as the nanophthalmic series; the study's primary groups (Table 3) are used
Subsets of the same eyes defined by intraoperative phaco energy, not separate groups
Same baseline as Table 3; Table 3 cells are cited for the whole series

exclusions.what: Table 3 IOP, BCVA, CCT, CDE and phaco-time rows; P columns; Table 5 regression
exclusions.reason: Not endothelial cell density; p-values and model estimates are not admissible

notes: Role: nanophthalmos is a patient condition (protocol); both groups had phacoemulsification without an investigational agent, so both are control-role groups. The nanophthalmic eyes also had prophylactic posterior sclerostomy and prior laser iridotomy.
One nanophthalmic eye with malignant glaucoma (vitrectomy after 1 month) was removed from all postoperative analyses; the Table 3 header still states n = 19.
Control eyes: 42 eyes of 21 patients (both eyes of each control patient).
